data.explanation:
HVA Foods PLC experienced severe financial strain in the most recent financial year, generating a substantial net loss alongside negative operating cash flows and negative equity. Revenue contracted significantly from the prior year while total liabilities continued to outweigh liquid assets, placing substantial pressure on working capital. Reflecting this weakness, the company has maintained a decade-long policy of withholding dividend payments, disbursing no dividends to shareholders in the latest financial year.

Key risks to the business include chronic operational deficits, high debt obligations, and broader economic headwinds. Because the company currently pays no dividends to its investors, there is no dividend to cut, resulting in a zero percent expected dividend cut for the upcoming financial year.
